title: Render purity in practice
description: Investigate render purity in React 19 with a defective starter, repaired instructor module, executable offline contract and framework example.
objectives: Diagnose the render purity failure through a real example
Repair the learner fixture with a precise invariant and explicit edge cases
Verify the result offline and distinguish those checks from framework end-to-end tests
rubric: I can reproduce the specific render purity failure in the learner starter
I can explain one positive and one negative case without a hosted service
I can identify which behavior still requires a browser or Next.js request integration test
